'''Vibrostaffs''' (also known as '''vibrostaves''' or '''vibro-staves''') were [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]] that employed intense vibration to make their strikes more effective.

==Characteristics==
Vibrostaffs were blunt melee weapons that came in single and double-handed varieties, and were typically several meters long; the intense vibrations generated by the weapon made the blunt impact of the weapon much stronger than normal, allowing a skilled wielder to cause considerable damage to both armored and unarmored opponents.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
